model_output.verdict: A healthcare COO with a substantial operating remit and measurable results across growth, integration and retention.
write_up: This is a strong COO resume! You show the business you run at Lakeshore and connect your work to faster integrations and lower turnover. The earlier clinic roles make the progression into multi-site leadership easy to follow.

The integration line is a great model: it names the playbook you standardized and the change in time. Your current role also puts the practice count, workforce, revenue and board relationship up front, so a recruiter doesn't have to guess how big the job is.

Your resume isn't the thing standing between you and a callback. The match with a company's needs and how competitive the role is will matter too. If you're aiming for a CEO role, we can add an enterprise-wide decision and more about your board work where you can substantiate them.
